name: Vector Golf
notion: A vector is a move: how far right, how far up. Two moves in a row add up tip to tail.

tiers.banner: Shots are shown with their coordinates
NEW RULE · NO PATH — add the shots in your head
NEW RULE · NUMBERS ONLY — predict where the ball stops

story.intro: Welcome to the Grid. The golf course forgot that a vector is a move, so let us remind it.
story.cleared: The golf course is back on. Moves add up again, tip to tail.
